final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS a FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), b AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS base FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL), k1 AS (SELECT r.rating, r.a FROM r, b WHERE r.a > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m1 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.rating, k1.a FROM k1, m WHERE k1.a > m.m1) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(k2.a - b.base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(k2.a - m.m1) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM k2, b, m
